# routeros_system_package_update (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `channel` (String) The release channel that is queried for the available RouterOS version.
  * development;
  * long-term;
  * stable;
  * testing.
- `check_certificate` (String) Whether the certificate of the upgrade server is verified when `mode` is `https`.
  * no;
  * yes;
  * yes-without-crl - verify the certificate but do not check the CRL.
- `ip_version` (String) The IP protocol version used to contact the upgrade server.
  * auto;
  * ipv4;
  * ipv6.
- `mode` (String) The protocol used to reach the upgrade server.
  * http;
  * https.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_version` (String) The RouterOS version that is currently installed.
- `latest_version` (String) The latest RouterOS version available in the selected channel, filled in after a check.
- `status` (String) The result of the last update check.
